notes: All samples are evolved MG1655 populations (early/innovation vs endpoint/optimization) on non-native carbon sources; no wild-type or reference-genotype sample, so is_control left out. Mutated genes not given: perturbed_genes and global_regulator_perturbed left out. Non-native carbon sources are medium properties (treatment none). D-lyxose, D-2-deoxyribose, D-arabinose = other_sugar; m-tartrate = organic_acid.
